Needs changes before merge. One documentation item is still open. The code checks passed.

This is a re-review of the refresh head `6f302809e`. The refresh made two merges of main (`5721b0fff` and `4dba7019d`). It resolved eight conflicts. The refreshed diff adds no code beyond those merges and the conflict resolutions.

## Requested before merge

1. Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the 2D Pocket Boundary controls. Also show the 2D Offset Passes control for contrast. The body has no images. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit images to this PR branch. The pin `pocket2d_boundaries_shows_pick_protected_and_takes_viewport_click` proves the control and the viewport pick in a headless test. It does not replace a picture of the running GUI.

## Earlier findings - status

| Finding | Status |
|---|---|
| 1. Before/after screenshots in the body | Open. The body has no images. |
| 2. `Process change: yes` line | Closed. The refreshed diff changes no process file. The line is not needed. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not changed. |
| 3. Refresh against current main | Done. The trial merge is clean. |

## What looks good

- The trial merge with current `origin/main` (`9a84074bd`) is clean. It has no conflicts.
- The eight conflict resolutions keep both sides where each added lines.
- No refusal or safety rule is lost:
  - the overhead keep-out uses `p.clearance_z.max(z)` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid.rs:173`);
  - the crossing-free arc check stays (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid_level.rs:111`);
  - the helix guards stay (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/descent.rs:357`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/descent_dive.rs:104`).
- The supported-operation text is now `2D Pocket, 2D Offset, 3D Pocket, Face and Trace`. The code, the MCP tool text and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` agree.
- The new module `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid_level.rs` has a provenance line and is 239 lines.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` is added outside tests.
- No golden, fixture, snapshot PNG or `CHANGELOG.md` file changed.
- The test count goes up: motion `avoid_pocket` 3 to 6, app `do_not_touch` 3 to 5, UI `do_not_touch` 4 to 5.

## Local build and test results

Reviewed head: `6f302809eddbbca567eecfd7ad1eaf8ba980f802`.
Trial merge with `origin/main`: `9a84074bd54d750d0401e4fc668f968f05e4ae79`.
Where: locally, in my own worktree. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --lib` | PASS: 570 passed, 10 ignored |
| `camcraft-motion --test avoid_pocket` | PASS: 6 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test rest2d` | PASS: 13 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test rest_adaptive` | PASS: 11 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test rest_previous` | PASS: 6 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test rest_relief` | PASS: 2 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test rest_zigzag` | PASS: 2 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test do_not_touch` | PASS: 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test do_not_touch_face` | PASS: 3 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test mcp_doc_drift` | PASS: 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test rest_pocket` | PASS: 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test rest_previous_ops` | PASS: 7 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib egui_app::tests::do_not_touch` (CWD `crates/ui`) | PASS: 8 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 3 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |

The pin `pocket2d_do_not_touch_keeps_full_tool_clear_of_protected_face_and_edge` ran in the app `do_not_touch` suite and passed. The pin `pocket2d_without_do_not_touch_gives_identical_toolpath` ran and passed.

The author's quick gate on this head is green: 310 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. I did not run the full quick gate again. I ran the touched binaries by name.

## Targeted tests and lanes

- This diff changes toolpath and post-gate code. No test in `tests/golden/` moved.
- The light lane was selected: 2 twins (`motion light: lib`, `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel`). It did not finish in this round. Result: not run.
- No heavy lane ran. This is a `P3` PR. No heavy step is required.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

- The "Heavy lanes" section of the body names head `9606cf508` and base `74ea8988d`. That is stale for `6f302809e`. Refresh the head and base if you keep the section. Heavy lanes are not required for a PR.
- `docs/decisions/3345-do-not-touch-2d-pocket.md` says the wiring calls `pocket_avoid_entered_with_relief`. The merged code calls `pocket_avoid_entered_started`. This is a small text drift.
- The PR is stacked on #3353. Merge #3353 first, or retarget this PR before its merge.

The label `needs-rework` stays for the open screenshot item. The PR stays a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
